title: Paris 1606 complete bounded post-Canon tail and appendix census
scope: Complete bounded printed post-Canon tail and appended Suffragium of the Paris 1606 Cistercian missal. It begins with Orémus/Præcéptis on printed p. 197 left, immediately after and excluding the accepted strict Canon’s final Per omnia/Amen. The main Ordinary tail closes on printed p. 199 right with the departure rubric Sicque signans se, & inclinans recedat. The appended Suffragium pro pace Ecclesiastica & temporali on printed p. 200 is included through its final Amen before INCIPIT SANCTORALE on p. 201. The appendix is printed after the main closure but its own rubric assigns recitation after the Canon’s Pater noster; units retain physical source order rather than silently relocating it. This is a bounded composite functional selection, not an assertion of an uninterrupted printed chapter or complete Ordinary. All in-scope prayers, abbreviated incipits, rubrics, response cues, crosses and sung words are included under the disclosed normalization. The prior 7-unit offertory and 35-unit Canon remain unchanged. Whole-Missal and complete-Ordinary text coverage remain partial; no wording or ancestry is inherited.

pages.description: Post-Canon Orémus/Præcéptis introduction, complete Pater noster and actual response/Amen. The earlier strict-Canon material above the starting Orémus remains facsimile context only. All musical notes and running-head furniture are excluded, all selected sung words retained.
Complete Libera and its conclusion; Per omnia/Amen, Pax dialogue with all three crosses, mixing rubric/prayer and the first two Agnus Dei source forms.

Main Ordinary tail from the third Agnus through the departure rubric, including the funerals variant, peace, communion, added prayers, post-communion prayers and all intervening instructions. Main Order closure occurs here.

Complete appended Suffragium pro pace with heading/instruction, short incipits, versicles/responses, Oremus and prayers through final Amen. Physical placement after the main closure remains distinct from its instructed after-Pater recitation position. INCIPIT catchword is excluded and points to the out-of-scope Sanctorale.
Printed p. 201 INCIPIT SANCTORALE and its opening material are retained solely as the excluded next-division boundary; no literal unit from this page enters the post-Canon constituent.
